n_input = int(input())
k_input = int(input())
mod_input = int(input())

factorials = [1] * (n_input + 1)
invs = [1] * (n_input + 1)
cache_dp = [[-1] * (n_input + 1) for _ in range(27)]

def lowbit_value(x):
    return x & (-x)

def fast_pow_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod_input
        base = (base * base) % mod_input
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def prepare():
    for i in range(1, n_input + 1):
        factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % mod_input
    invs[n_input] = fast_pow_mod(factorials[n_input], mod_input - 2)
    for i in range(n_input - 1, -1, -1):
        invs[i] = (invs[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod_input

def compute(x, s):
    if cache_dp[x][s] != -1:
        return cache_dp[x][s]
    if s == 0:
        cache_dp[x][s] = (factorials[n_input] * factorials[k_input] % mod_input) * invs[k_input - x] % mod_input
        return cache_dp[x][s]
    rem = s - lowbit_value(s)
    total_sum = 0
    t = rem
    while t:
        total_sum = (total_sum + compute(x + 1, t) * invs[s - t]) % mod_input
        t = (t - 1) & rem
    total_sum = (total_sum + compute(x + 1, 0) * invs[s]) % mod_input
    cache_dp[x][s] = total_sum
    return total_sum

prepare()
result = fast_pow_mod(k_input, n_input)
if n_input % 2 == 0:
    for i in range(27):
        for j in range(n_input + 1):
            cache_dp[i][j] = -1
    result = (result - compute(0, n_input) + mod_input) % mod_input
print(result)
